Merry SK Hynix US IPO day to all that celebrate

Here's what to expect:

SK Hynix will begin trading today around the middle of the day. We don't have an exact time but generally its between 12PM ET - 1PM ET

SK Hynix will begin trading today under the stock ticker $SKHYV but it will trade under that ticker for JUST today

On Monday SK Hynix's ticker will switch to $SKHY which will then be its US stock ticker going forward

And then some more of the dates for the traders:

On Tuesday the leveraged and inverse ETFs should begin trading

- 2x Long SK Hynix = $SKHX
- 1x Short SK Hynix = $SKHZ
 
The SK Hynix options chain will then launch after that. The earliest I expect to see the SK options chain would be Wednesday but it could be later than that
